summary.text: Sandy Pappas is a Democratic-Farmer-Labor member of the Minnesota Senate for District 65, elected to the House in 1984 and to the Senate in 1990.

Her official Senate page lists committee assignments including Capital Investment, Finance, Judiciary and Public Safety, Labor, and Rules and Administration, and shows her in her eleventh Senate term.

sources.title: Senator Sandy Pappas (65, DFL) - Minnesota Senate
